scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n "next,electron" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run electron"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:next && npm run postbuild:next && npx prisma generate && electron-builder
scripts.dev:mssql: npm run prepare:mssql && npx prisma generate && node scripts/env-run.js DB_PROVIDER=mssql "next dev"
scripts.dev:sqlite: npm run prepare:sqlite && npx prisma generate && node scripts/env-run.js DB_PROVIDER=sqlite "next dev"
scripts.build:mssql: npm run prepare:mssql && npx prisma generate && node scripts/env-run.js DB_PROVIDER=mssql "next build"
scripts.build:sqlite: npm run prepare:sqlite && npx prisma generate && node scripts/env-run.js DB_PROVIDER=sqlite "next build"
scripts.electron:build:mssql: npm run prepare:mssql && npx prisma generate && node scripts/env-run.js DB_PROVIDER=mssql "next build && node scripts/copy-standalone-assets.js && electron-builder"
scripts.electron:build:sqlite: npm run prepare:sqlite && npx prisma generate && node scripts/env-run.js DB_PROVIDER=sqlite "next build && node scripts/copy-standalone-assets.js && electron-builder"
